crops.alt: Four camp notices. A is a camp near the lake offering swimming, scuba diving, canoeing, dances and films for ages 12 to 14 in June or July. B has drama, music, art and crafts for ages 7 to 9 in autumn and spring. C is in the Scottish countryside with skiing, skating and hockey for ages 10 to 12 all winter. D offers climbing, volleyball, tennis, golf and other games for ages 14 to 15 all summer.
